nurse.text: Fáilte go Luimneach! That's 'welcome to Limerick'. You've a tired look about you. Pop them on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit down there. There's tea in the pot and a biscuit if you're quick.
Right as rain. Which is handy, because it's raining.
The Ark's in the corner, behind the umbrella stand.

else.text: Grand so. Mind yourself on the quays.
